description:
Ohr | Data Engineer + Software Engineer | REMOTE (US) | $140K–$200K + Equity Ohr is reinventing industrial chemistry from the atom up—turning breakthrough science into industrial alchemy. We're hiring two engineers to help build the computational infrastructure behind it: Data Engineer — Build the data foundation connecting laboratory instruments, scientific data, enterprise platforms, analytics, and AI systems. Software Engineer — Build production AI tools, molecule-discovery applications, internal systems, and digital twins for processes scaling from lab to manufacturing. We're looking for builders excited to learn the science and have their code touch the physical world. 4–8 years experience. U.S. person status required due to export-controlled systems.
